title: fss.scene_feature_multimatch_retained.v2
description: Version 2 retains all original source custody, camera and geometry evidence and adds each view complete image_processing record. Original codec luma/dimensions remain in source; actual feature pixels/domain/dimensions appear in image_processing output. Corrected records bind the full declared raw/target model, original exposure/storage/mask/layout/range, actual sampling map, corrected output/mask and complete geometric/privacy sample accounting. The original exposure is preserved; output correction creates neither independent evidence nor measured calibration. Source/current-privacy revalidation still follows complete analysis and final read costs include those checks. SHA-256 hashes exact UTF-8 report-body bytes. All v1 pair/component semantics, complete inventory bounds and output caps remain unchanged.

signed128.description: Exact original signed i128 nanoseconds, never rounded through a JSON floating-point number.
